meta.name: browser-cdp
meta.description: Use this skill when you need to control a Chrome browser via CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) to reuse existing login sessions. Covers: launching Chrome in debug mode, opening URLs, waiting for page load, evaluating JavaScript, taking snapshots, and extracting auth tokens. Trigger phrases: browser automation, CDP, agent-browser, 浏览器操作, 操作浏览器, Chrome CDP, 复用登录态, extract token from browser.

copy.tagline: 用 CDP 控制浏览器，复用登录态提取所需数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要用脚本控制 Chrome 完成自动化操作
copy.tagline_en: Control Chrome via CDP to reuse logins and extract data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need scripted Chrome control for automation

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过 CDP 控制你本机的 Chrome：打开网址、等待加载、运行 JavaScript、读取页面文字、提取登录 token。它能复用已有登录态做自动化操作；启动前会先检查，必要时征求你同意再重启。
howto.when: 当你提到“浏览器操作”“CDP”“复用登录态”等触发词，或要求用浏览器做自动化操作时触发。

say.text: 帮我在 Chrome 里打开 example.com，然后读出页面主要文字
say.note: Claude 会先连接 CDP，再执行打开和读取

say.text: 从浏览器会话里取出登录 token
在页面上找到登录按钮并点击，然后输入用户名
say.note: Claude 会做页面快照后操作

howto.what_en: Claude can control local Chrome via CDP: open URLs, wait for load, run JavaScript, read page text, and extract auth tokens. It reuses existing login sessions. Before launch, it probes state and asks consent if a restart is needed.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention trigger phrases like 'browser operations', 'CDP', 'reuse login state', or ask to automate the browser.

say_en.text: Open example.com in Chrome and read the main text.
say_en.note: Claude connects via CDP, opens, then reads.

say_en.text: Extract the login token from the browser session.
Find the login button, click it, and type the username.
say_en.note: Claude takes a snapshot, then clicks and types.
